paraphrase: To the Lord reclining at Kuṭantai: did your feet ache from walking (as Vāmana, as Rāma)? did your body tire from lifting the earth as the boar? — rise and speak to me, Lord who lies at Kuṭantai.
speaker: Tirumaḻicai Āḻvār
notes: Tradition: the image at Kumbakōṇam (Ārāvamutaṉ) began to rise and remains half-risen (uttāna-śāyin). Content recalled with confidence; exact verse number to verify.
